source_kind: sanitized minimal excerpts from authentic public failed-job logs; no synthetic reproduction
selection_policy: Convenience sample from recent public failures in repositories absent from the previous design set, retaining supported, unsupported and aggregate-only unknown observations. Expectations were saved before invoking either analyzer. This is not random sampling or generalization accuracy.

cases.expected_observed_category: Python timing assertion differs from a threshold
cases.missing_evidence_and_limitations: Actual duration is 0.1947 s against <0.1 s. The evidence does not establish whether scheduling variance, implementation or the threshold is responsible.

cases.failed_step_from_api: Decide whether the needed jobs succeeded or failed
cases.expected_observed_category: Required predecessor job failed; aggregate job contains no originating diagnostic
cases.missing_evidence_and_limitations: This aggregate-only input omits the predecessor job diagnostic. Its exit status cannot identify the source failure.
cases.near_match_guard: An error exit marker alone must not become a Python test or module diagnostic.

cases.expected_observed_category: Artifact search found no matching eligible workflow run
cases.missing_evidence_and_limitations: The action reports allow-forks=false and a skipped fork. The excerpt does not prove that this is the sole reason no eligible artifacts matched.
cases.near_match_guard: No matching workflow artifacts are not a dependency resolver error or local missing-file proof.

cases.expected_observed_category: uv cannot find pyproject.toml in the current directory or its ancestors
cases.missing_evidence_and_limitations: The source diagnostic is explicit, but this exact uv form has no supported signature. The log does not identify the expected project directory or why the file is absent.

cases.expected_observed_category: Prettier pre-commit hook failed because it modified files
cases.missing_evidence_and_limitations: Formatter and changed-file condition are observed. The excerpt does not include all formatting diffs. Prettier formatting is outside current categories.
cases.near_match_guard: Failed + files modified + passing mypy is not the supported Ruff formatting hook or a type-check failure.

cases.expected_observed_category: Repository policy requests a matching CHANGES.md entry or skip-news label
cases.missing_evidence_and_limitations: The emitted repository policy failure is identifiable, but no changelog category exists. No checkout was inspected and no label change was made.
cases.near_match_guard: A command exit code does not prove dependency, test, permissions or formatting failure.

cases.expected_observed_category: Cargo registry dependency download failed with curl HTTP2 framing error 16
cases.missing_evidence_and_limitations: The registry HTTP2 transport diagnostic is explicit; transient network, proxy and peer causes are unproved. No dedicated transport category exists.
cases.near_match_guard: Dependency acquisition during cargo build is not a rustc compile diagnostic or an incompatible-version resolver diagnosis.

acquisition_exclusions.reason: Run metadata exposed no jobs; gh --log-failed returned log not found. Not analyzed or counted.
Run metadata exposed no jobs; gh --log-failed returned log not found. Not analyzed or counted.

limitations: Only seven deliberately selected excerpts from six newly reviewed public failed runs; cases are not independent random draws.

The aggregate-only unknown excerpt comes from a run whose separate failing job has a supported assertion; withholding that job limits that input by design, without asserting the full run is unknowable.
gh failed-job log output reports UNKNOWN STEP in five of six runs; named failed steps come from separate run metadata and were not inserted into fixture text.
No target checkout, repair, test execution, workflow rerun or successful-fix measurement.
Source freeze proves which diagnostic implementation was evaluated; matching replay expectations later is a regression check, not independent accuracy.
